_doc: Main balance file. Times are in GAME minutes unless the key says otherwise. Money is in $k.
title: Seismic Shift
subtitle: A GeoHazard Analyst shift-management roguelike

display._doc: The game is laid out for 1920x1080 and scales to any window. F11 switches between fullscreen and a window.

auto_assign._doc: Auto-assign (the AUTO switch on the shift screen). horizon_minutes: modes other than 'fastest' and 'balanced' avoid stacking more than this much work on one analyst while someone else has room. check_every_minutes: how often (game minutes) the inbox is re-checked.

time._doc: day_length_seconds = real seconds for one 24 h game day at 1x speed.

shifts._doc: Shifts in order from the start of the game day (day_start_hour). fatigue_mult scales fatigue gain, ltf_mult long-term fatigue per shift.

roster._doc: Teams and their rotation. Each team follows rotation_cycle (one entry per day: a shift key or 'off'); team n is team_start_days[n] days into the cycle on the first day of the run. With the defaults exactly one team works each shift.

difficulty._doc: Each day of the run is picked from the catalogue by workload percentile. The target percentile ramps from start to end across the run, with a smaller ramp inside each week.

catalog._doc: Drop a CSV (e.g. archive.csv from eq_stats or a GeoNet quakesearch export) into data/catalog/. Without one, a synthetic NZ catalogue is generated. Catalogue times are UTC; nz_daylight_saving converts them to NZ time (NZST/NZDT). Set it to false to use a fixed utc_offset_hours instead.

eq._doc: work = minutes for a skill-3, fresh analyst. Events above two_stage_above get a prelim + confirm (confirm locked until the prelim is done).

skill_model._doc: speed = 1 + speed_per_level * (level - 3) * (cw_base + cw_per * complexity). error = error_base_per_complexity * complexity * error_skill_base^(3 - level).

fatigue._doc: Short-term fatigue 0-100. Builds on shift, recovers off shift, can't recover below long_term * floor_from_ltf.

long_term._doc: Long-term fatigue 0-100. Added at the end of each shift worked; only a week of leave reduces it. Reaching burnout_level means the analyst resigns.

rating._doc: Public trust. Errors cost importance * error_penalty. Overdue tasks cost importance * miss_penalty once, then drain until capped at importance * overdue_cap_mult. All overdue drain together is capped per game hour.

centre._doc: Centre (meta) progression, kept per save slot across runs. level_xp[n] = total XP needed for level n+1. XP per run: per_week for each week completed, per_sop for each SOP event handled, per_task for each task done, plus win_per_week x the run length and win_trust x final trust if you finish the season. Items in relics/consumables/training.json with an unlock_level above the centre level don't appear in the shop.
